sections.title: Q22 · Our own members
sections.description: Q22 (proposal 1.4.1-1.4.3), recommended A:  what a class of ours holds or works out (getters, methods, cells, memos, fields) is `is` / `has` / `can` (or `was` / `should` / `needs`), or a verb that already asks the question;  never a bare adjective

sections.title: Q23 · Settings
sections.description: Q23 (1.4.4), recommended A:  options, props and `@proto static` switches are bare, the platform's way (`{ once: true }`);  a noun keeps `is` / `has`;  the field a setting is copied into takes its name

sections.title: Q24 · Data records
sections.description: Q24 (1.4.5), recommended A:  records we define follow the members rule (`is` / `has`, or a verb);  shapes copied from outside (JSON on disk, LSP, Fomantic, platform, upstream ports) keep their names

sections.title: Q25 · Locals and yes / no functions
sections.description: Q25 (1.4.6), recommended A:  locals and parameters free (a noun takes `is`);  a yes / no function is `is` / `has` / `can` or a verb:  `sameX(a, b)` becomes `isSameX(a, b)`, like `node.isSameNode(other)`

sections.title: Q26 · Derived reads:  call or getter
sections.description: Q26 (1.4.7), recommended A:  in a Solid controller a tracked yes / no read is a call (a method or a memo);  an untracked read, and anything outside controllers, is a getter
